source_en: Sorry, here's the form. I did it twice. Luka Tsereteli. I'm ten.
School stopped two weeks ago. My teacher [[whisper:never came back]].
Mum sent me for bread. She can't stand in lines anymore.
He took the bus east to see his sister. The bus came back empty.
My dad's in Varka for work. Mum keeps calling. The phones don't connect.
My hands shake. Mum says it's the cold. It isn't cold.
A week ago. He said not to drink the tap water. Then the line cut.
Coming here helps. It's always the same.
